_what: One record per experiment reading this project has ever taken: ablations, grids, ship gates, deletion gates, fits, anchor ladders. Harvested 2026-09-24 from .github/experiments.json (arm shapes come from there verbatim) and from every notes tree; `reading` is null where the number was not transcribed and `notes` says where the telling lives.
_how_to_use: BEFORE designing or dispatching an arm: grep this file for the knob and read every entry for it -- an arm whose question was answered is a wasted runner and a duplicated telling (2026-09-24: five of eleven ablation arms replicated run 35306328917 because its verdicts lived only in prose). AT DISPATCH: add the arm here (status in_flight, run id after the dispatch). AT READ: fill reading/verdict/status and the note path. tests/test_experiment_ledger.py fails on an arm in the registry with no entry here.

_schema.id: unique slug; registry arms use their slug verbatim
_schema.kind: ablation | grid-point | ship-gate | deletion-gate | bundle | fit | anchor | anchor-ladder | diagnostic | smoke | ablation-batch
_schema.knobs: what was varied, name -> arm setting (dict of several for bundles)
_schema.ref: the arm code: a SHA, branch, or era shorthand
_schema.compare_to: the paired base, if the reading is a paired difference
_schema.run: the workflow run id, or null where the notes do not record one
_schema.reading: the number as the note states it (mean [interval], or paired diff [interval]); null = not transcribed
_schema.verdict: what the pre-registered rule said, in one line
_schema.status: answered | planned (registered, not dispatched) | in_flight | unrecorded (ran, no verdict located anywhere)
_schema.notes: every telling of this reading; one measurement has one telling, so usually one path

_gaps: reading=null means the number lives only in its note; the map is complete, the transcription is not (restore-chain02/04/08, restore-both, sandbox-2000, guard-sweep-*, fit-clean-*, margin-deleted, reply-gate-B/q1/q2/f5, event-scale-15-20, rb-budget-models).
verdicts located nowhere (status unrecorded): guard-sweep-* on block 50000-51023 -- if their notes exist under another name, fill them in.
drift.yml anchor runs and ordinary PR gates are not in here by design; only runs that answered a question about the bot.
the 2026-09-09..09-11 era (mcts, win-probability notes) predates the run-id discipline and is represented only where a number was quotable (vp-swing-1x, scoring-discount-055, ablate-access-chain).
